long_biography.plain_text:
Marafi entered Kuwait's Ministry of Foreign Affairs in 1993 after earning a political-science degree at Kuwait University. His formative assignment was the permanent mission in Geneva, where he progressed from diplomatic attaché to counsellor and represented Kuwait in United Nations human-rights proceedings.

He subsequently became Kuwait's ambassador to Austria and permanent representative to Vienna-based international organisations. That posting included chairing the Arab ambassadors' council and election as president of the IAEA General Conference in 2021. A subsequent appointment sent him to China before he returned to Kuwait as an assistant foreign minister, directing work across European and multilateral relationships.
